summary: Tested the restored Copertura oraria (Staff/Volontari) on TEST_Maratona Copertura (TEST org, test_cov_admin). Backend: new test_iter210_coverage_restore.py, 15/15 pass. Every expected count matched: the default (attivi) 12/12 slots run 06:00..18:00 with 2/2/3/3/3/2/2 then 2 x6, team counts {Ristoro:2,Pacer:1} at 09 and {Ristoro:1,Accoglienza:1} from 13 to 19, KPI 4 people and tbc 1. With stato=confermati the counts are 1/1/2/2/2/1/1 then 1. On 13/12 the 06-13 slots show 1 Accoglienza. The Ristoro filter, 30/15-minute steps (26/52 slots) and step=20 returning 400 all work. to-update returns Blu, Gialli, Neri. Matrix cells at 09:00 are [3,1]. PDF summary/by_mansione/names and XLSX exports return 200 with valid magic bytes. Rinuncia and DaClass never appear. UI (1920): chart visible, Per Team selected by default with stacked colored segments and an alphabetical legend (Accoglienza, Pacer, Ristoro), Complessivo shows Intera fascia/Parziale. cov-stato, cov-team (alphabetical), cov-date, cov-step and Più giorni all work. Clicking cov-slot-09:00 lists Bianchi, Neri (with the legacy badge) and Rossi. The 'Disponibilità da aggiornare: 3' dialog opens Neri's record; ticking Mattina for 12/12 and saving dropped the count to 2 and the chart went to 3 at 06-13. Stati were not changed. PDF/Excel buttons download files. Mobile 390: no horizontal page overflow and the dialog opens, but the bar track is very narrow. No page errors.

minor.issue: The frontend does not pass `stato` to to-update. With 'Solo stato Confermato' selected, the indicator still counts people who are not Confermato (Gialli, who is da_contattare). The backend accepts stato, but CoverageToUpdate's q/deps omit params.stato.

issues: The bar row uses grid-cols-[86px_1fr_170px]. The fixed 170px numbers column leaves only about 44px for the bar, so the team segments are barely readable. Use a smaller or auto numbers column on mobile (e.g. grid-cols-[72px_1fr_auto]), or put the numbers below the bar.
The slot dialog table is cut off horizontally on mobile (Taglia/Orario/Assegnazione columns are off-screen). Check that it is wrapped in overflow-x-auto.
PersonMask.jsx:80 hint says 'Solo Staff e Volontari Confermati entrano nella Copertura oraria'. This is no longer true: the default now includes every stato except rinunce.
CoverageFasceDialogs.jsx:92 LegacyDialog text says 'Staff e Volontari confermati con disponibilità...'. It now includes everyone who is not a rinuncia.
